narrative.scqa_md:
United Federal Credit Union is a $4.2B in assets credit union regulated by NCUA with 704 employees. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.5/5. The deepest capability gap is Notification Template & Alert Configuration at 2.0/5 against a 3.0 peer median. Next is Optimization & Learning at 2.1/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-061, E-062]. Third is STP Monitoring & Reporting at 2.2/5 against a 2.8 peer median [E-043, E-080].

The issue register adds P1_Scoring_Detail has 188 rows, expected ~199 (high severity). The issue register adds P2_Scoring_Detail has 233 rows, expected ~288 (high severity). Counter-signal: Semantic Layer & Knowledge Graph already runs at 3.5/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The pattern is corroborated across the assessment's evidence index [E-002, E-081]. The roster shows no CISO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below.

The question for United Federal Credit Union is whether to close Notification Template & Alert Configuration first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. United Federal Credit Union should lead with Tableau (70/100 fit) against Strategy Foundation & Alignment, then sequence Databricks behind it. Closing Notification Template & Alert Configuration to the peer median alone is worth 1.0 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain. The analyst's own priority framing: "Commercial/SBA growth cornerstone outpaces relationship infrastructure (→OBJ-1, HIGH) — Commercial & SBA lending named the growth cornerstone…".
